title_overlay: Top 20 Soccer Goals With The Most Aura
hook: These goals didn't just win games. They broke the internet. Let's count them down.

items.label: Captain America
items.line: Pulisic scores against Iran and gets flattened by the keeper in the same second. He literally sacrificed his body for the group stage. That is the most American thing that ever happened on a soccer field.
items.line_short: Scored and got flattened in the same second. Peak American aura.
items.clip_hint: Christian Pulisic goal vs Iran, World Cup 2022 (collides with the keeper as he scores)

items.label: Manchester Acrobat
items.line: Cross comes in a little behind him, so he just decides to fly. Bicycle kick, top corner, in a derby. The man celebrated like he knew he'd never top it, and honestly he never did.
items.line_short: Ball behind him? No problem. Bro just took off.
items.clip_hint: Wayne Rooney overhead kick vs Manchester City, Premier League 2011

items.label: French Scorpion
items.line: Ball is behind him, he's falling forward, and he still flicks it in with his heel off the crossbar. Physics teachers hate this clip. Goalkeepers have nightmares about it.
items.line_short: Falling forward and still scored with his heel. Make it make sense.
items.clip_hint: Olivier Giroud scorpion kick goal vs Crystal Palace, January 1, 2017

items.label: Armenian Magician
items.line: Same move, but he was offside-looking for half a second and nobody cared because the finish was that disrespectful. Scorpion kick on Boxing Day. Santa came early.
items.line_short: Scorpion kick on Boxing Day. Santa came early.
items.clip_hint: Henrikh Mkhitaryan scorpion kick vs Sunderland, December 26, 2016

items.label: Rabona Merchant
items.line: Inside the box, in a derby, with the wrong foot wrapped behind the right. Anybody else gets benched for trying this. He won the Puskás award for it.
items.line_short: Rabona in a derby. Anybody else gets benched. He won the Puskás.
items.clip_hint: Erik Lamela rabona goal vs Arsenal, March 2021

items.label: Flying Dutchman
items.line: Long ball from forty yards, and he heads it while horizontal in the air, over the keeper, against the world champions. They call it the flying Dutchman for a reason.
items.line_short: Horizontal header over the world champs. The Flying Dutchman.
items.clip_hint: Robin van Persie diving header vs Spain, World Cup 2014

items.label: Stoppage Time Legend
items.line: Ninety-first minute, USA about to go home, and Landon Donovan finishes the rebound. Every bar in America lost its mind. If you know, you know. Go USA.
items.line_short: Ninety-first minute. Every bar in America lost its mind.
items.clip_hint: Landon Donovan stoppage-time winner vs Algeria, World Cup 2010

items.label: Miami Vice
items.line: First game in pink, last minute, free kick. You already know where it's going and so does the goalkeeper. Still can't stop it. That's how you introduce yourself to America.
items.line_short: Debut in pink, last-minute free kick. Hello, America.
items.clip_hint: Lionel Messi last-minute free kick on his Inter Miami debut vs Cruz Azul, Leagues Cup 2023

items.label: Colombian Rocket
items.line: Chest control, turn, volley off the crossbar, in a World Cup knockout game. He went into that tournament a prospect and came out with the Golden Boot.
items.line_short: Chest, turn, volley, crossbar, in. World Cup knockout. Insane.
items.clip_hint: James Rodríguez chest-and-volley goal vs Uruguay, World Cup 2014

items.label: Toe Poke Wizard
items.line: No run up, no backlift, just a little shimmy and a toe poke into the corner. Four defenders standing there like NPCs waiting for the game to load.
items.line_short: No backlift, just a toe poke. Defenders standing like NPCs.
items.clip_hint: Ronaldinho toe-poke goal vs Chelsea, Champions League 2005

items.label: Hat Trick Hero
items.line: Last day of the season, needs a goal for Champions League football, and he completes the hat trick with a bicycle kick from outside the box. Main character, clearly.
items.line_short: Needs a goal on the final day. Bicycle kick from outside the box.
items.clip_hint: Rivaldo bicycle kick completing his hat-trick vs Valencia, 2001

items.label: Dutch Spin Doctor
items.line: He flicks it one way, spins the other, and the defender is left in another timezone. People still argue if it was on purpose. Doesn't matter. Pure aura.
items.line_short: Flick, spin, defender in another timezone. Pure aura.
items.clip_hint: Dennis Bergkamp turn and goal vs Newcastle, Premier League 2002

items.label: Turin Standing Ovation
items.line: Bicycle kick so clean the opposing fans stood up and clapped. When the other team's stadium applauds you, the debate is over.
items.line_short: Bicycle kick so clean the opposing fans clapped.
items.clip_hint: Cristiano Ronaldo bicycle kick vs Juventus, Champions League 2018 (Juventus fans applaud)

items.label: Welsh Wonder
items.line: Comes off the bench in a Champions League final and scores a bicycle kick within minutes. Imagine being that comfortable on the biggest stage on Earth.
items.line_short: Off the bench, Champions League final, bicycle kick. Calm.
items.clip_hint: Gareth Bale bicycle kick, Champions League final 2018 vs Liverpool

items.label: Swedish Ninja
items.line: Thirty-plus yards out, ball in the air, keeper off his line, so naturally he goes for an overhead kick. Against England. He scored four that night and this was the one people remember.
items.line_short: Thirty yards, overhead kick, against England. Ninja behavior.
items.clip_hint: Zlatan Ibrahimović 30+ yard bicycle kick vs England, November 2012

items.label: Getafe Solo Run
items.line: Picks it up at halfway and just goes. Dribbles past half the team, rounds the keeper, scores. People said it was a copy of a legendary goal. We'll get to that one.
items.line_short: Halfway line, past half the team, rounds the keeper. Ridiculous.
items.clip_hint: Lionel Messi solo goal vs Getafe, Copa del Rey 2007

items.label: Dutch Volley King
items.line: Euro final, ball comes from the wing at an impossible angle, and he volleys it in from the corner of the box. Even his coach couldn't believe it.
items.line_short: Euro final, impossible angle, volley into the far corner.
items.clip_hint: Marco van Basten volley, Euro 1988 final vs USSR

items.label: Bald French Maestro
items.line: Ball drops from the sky, he swivels and volleys it into the top corner with his weaker foot, in a Champions League final. Elegant is an understatement.
items.line_short: Champions League final, weak foot volley, top corner. Elegance.
items.clip_hint: Zinedine Zidane volley, Champions League final 2002 vs Bayer Leverkusen

items.label: Brazilian Banana
items.line: From thirty-five yards the ball goes so far wide that a ball boy ducks, then it bends back into the net. Scientists literally wrote papers about this one.
items.line_short: Ball goes wide, then bends back in. Scientists wrote papers on it.
items.clip_hint: Roberto Carlos free kick vs France, Tournoi de France 1997

items.label: The Original GOAT Run
items.line: World Cup quarterfinal, starts in his own half, beats five players and the goalkeeper. Voted the goal of the century. Every solo run since is just a remake.
items.line_short: World Cup, own half, beats everyone. Goal of the century.
items.clip_hint: Diego Maradona solo goal vs England, World Cup 1986 ('Goal of the Century', not the handball)

outro: Which one is number one for you? Drop it in the comments, and subscribe for more.

youtube.description:
The 20 soccer goals with the most aura of all time — from Pulisic and Donovan to Messi, Zidane, Roberto Carlos and Maradona. Which one is #1 for you? 👇
